helplines.name: National Emergency Service 999
helplines.description_en: Toll-free national call centre providing emergency police, fire service and ambulance services.
helplines.hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
helplines.evidence: ৯৯৯ একটি টোল ফ্রি নাম্বার ... জরুরি পুলিশ, জরুরি ফায়ার সার্ভিস ও জরুরি এ্যাম্বুলেন্স সেবা প্রদান করা হয় ... সপ্তাহে ৭ দিন ২৪ ঘন্টা চালু রয়েছে এ কল সেন্টার ... এই নাম্বারে কল করার জন্য কলারকে কোন টাকা খরচ করতে হয় না (999 is a toll-free number ... emergency police, fire service and ambulance services are provided ... the call centre runs 24 hours, 7 days a week ... callers do not have to spend any money to call this number)

helplines.name: National Helpline Centre for Violence Against Women and Children 109
helplines.description_en: National helpline under the Ministry of Women and Children Affairs' Multi-Sectoral Programme on Violence Against Women that gives women and child victims of violence and their families information, advice and referral to support services.
helplines.evidence: মহিলা ও শিশু বিষয়ক মন্ত্রণালয়ের অধীন ... নারী ও শিশু নির্যাতন প্রতিরোধে ন্যাশনাল হেল্পলাইন সেন্টার প্রতিষ্ঠা করা হয়েছে ... সকল মোবাইল এবং অন্যান্য টেলিফোন হতে এই নম্বরে ফোন করা যায় ... এই সেন্টারে ২৪ ঘন্টা কল করা যাবে। (National Helpline Centre for prevention of violence against women and children established under the Ministry of Women and Children Affairs ... can be called from all mobile and other telephones ... can be called 24 hours.) Toll-free status from the DWA notice title 'নারী ও শিশু নির্যাতন প্রতিরোধে ন্যাশনাল হেল্পলাইন সেন্টারের টোল ফ্রি ১০৯ প্রসংগে' ('Regarding toll-free 109 of the National Helpline Centre...') at https://dwa.gov.bd/pages/notices/6922de00dbfbab28ce067b20

helplines.name: Child Helpline 1098
helplines.description_en: Free helpline run by the Department of Social Services (with UNICEF support) where a child, or anyone on a child's behalf, can seek help for violence, abuse or exploitation; provides information, immediate action and telephone counselling.
helplines.evidence: শিশু নিজে অথবা শিশুর হয়ে অন্য যে কোন ব্যক্তি বিনামূল্যে হেল্পলাইন-১০৯৮ এ ফোন করে সহায়তা চাইতে পারে ... দিন/রাত ২৪ ঘন্টা হেল্পলাইনটির কার্যক্রম পরিচালিত হচ্ছে ... শিশুর জরুরী সহায়তায় টোল-ফ্রি শর্ট কোড এ অভিগম্যতা ... টেলিফোনে তথ্য এবং কাউন্সেলিং সেবা প্রদান করা (The child or anyone on the child's behalf can call helpline 1098 free of charge ... operates 24 hours day/night ... access to a toll-free short code for children's emergency support ... providing information and counselling by telephone)

helplines.name: National Helpline 333
helplines.description_en: Government national helpline (a2i, ICT Division) for information on government services, complaints about social issues such as child marriage and violence against women and children, and assistance during emergencies or disasters.
helplines.evidence: শর্ট কোডঃ 333 (যে কোন মোবাইল হতে) ... লং কোডঃ 09666789333 (টেলিফোন ও বিদেশ হতে) ... কল চার্জঃ ৬০ পয়সা / মিনিট ... ২৪X৭ এবং ১X৩৬৫ (Short code 333 from any mobile; long code 09666789333 from landline/abroad; call charge 60 paisa/minute; 24x7 and 365 days). a2i page https://a2i.gov.bd/pages/static-pages/6922df18933eb65569e1fced: 'By dialing 333 from any mobile or landline phone, citizens can receive verified information on government services, lodge complaints on social issues (e.g. child marriage, violence against women and children ...), obtain assistance during national emergency or natural calamities'

helplines.name: Shastho Batayon 16263 (Health Call Centre)
helplines.description_en: DGHS health call centre where callers can speak directly to a doctor about any health matter (press 0), get information on government hospitals and doctors, get ambulance information, or lodge complaints; the official page does not mention mental-health counselling.
helplines.evidence: হেল্পলাইন নম্বর 16263(এক বাষট্টি তেষট্টি)-তে কল করে আপনি স্বাস্থ্য সংক্রান্ত যেকোন বিষয়ে সরাসরি ডাক্তারের পরামর্শ নিতে পারেন। এই হেল্পলাইন দিনরাত ২৪ ঘন্টা আপনার সেবায় নিয়োজিত। ... স্বাস্থ্য বাতায়ন কোন বানিজ্যিক সেবা নয় এবং এতে ফোন করতে মোবাইল ফোনের স্বাভাবিক বিলের অতিরিক্ত বিল হয়না। (By calling 16263 you can get direct doctor advice on any health matter; the helpline runs 24 hours day and night ... it is not a commercial service and calling costs nothing beyond the normal mobile bill.)

notes: KAAN PETE ROI SAFETY CONCERN: the bare domain https://kaanpeteroi.org/ still returns HTTP 301 to https://www.gcconstructionbuilders.com/, which today serves an Indonesian gambling page ('JOIN999 ... Situs Slot Gacor'). The domain looks compromised or lapsed. Do NOT link kaanpeteroi.org anywhere in the app. The subpage kaanpeteroi.org/helpline-service/ still serves an old WordPress page (dateModified 2024-04-23) showing '+880 9612-119911 ... 3:00 PM to 3:00 AM'.

Kaan Pete Roi sources conflict: LifeLine International's member page, findahelpline.com and The Daily Star (18 May 2024) all give 09612119911 and 3pm-3am daily. Befrienders Worldwide (https://befrienders.org/find-support-now/kaan-pete-roi/) instead lists mobile numbers +88 01985275286, +88 01852035634, +88 01517969150 and a malformed '+88 017795543912' (one digit too many, so not a valid number), all 'Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week', with website shuni.org. shuni.org is only a placeholder (logo and a link to facebook.com/kaan.pete.roi). The Facebook page (117,599 followers; description 'বাংলাদেশের প্রথম মানসিক সহায়তা ও আত্মহত্যা প্রতিরোধমূলক হেল্পলাইন' = 'Bangladesh's first emotional support and suicide prevention helpline') is behind a login wall, so only its meta tags could be read. KPR's current number and hours could not be confirmed from a source KPR controls. Marked UNCERTAIN; a person should check the Facebook page before the app shows the number.

16263: the official DGHS page does NOT mention mental-health counselling or tele-counselling. It only offers doctor advice on 'any health matter'. Search-engine summaries that claim a mental-health option are not supported by the official page. It is not toll-free: calls cost the normal mobile rate ('no charge beyond the normal mobile bill'). A hidden HTML comment on the page mentions an older tariff of Tk 0.60/min.
333: bangladesh.gov.bd gives a call charge of 60 paisa/minute, so it is not toll-free. The a2i page does not mention cost. The long code 09666789333 works from landlines and from abroad.
109: mspvaw.gov.bd did not resolve (DNS failure), so 109 was verified from dwa.gov.bd (Department of Women Affairs) instead.

1098: the old DSS page https://dss.gov.bd/site/page/89858044-e55d-4ff4-be56-8c2b87ab1099/Child-Helpline-1098 now only shows an old CSPB project note. The current official page is https://dss.gov.bd/pages/static-pages/6922e007933eb65569e2519a.

NIMH: the site header shows 'হটলাইন : +৮৮ ০১৭০১-২৪৮০৪৪' (hotline) without saying what it is for, so it is not listed as a crisis helpline. The contact page also shows '+৮৮ ০১৩৪০-৩৩৭৭৩৩' next to the feedback section. nimh.gov.bd/contacts/ returns 404; the working page is nimh.gov.bd/contact.php.
No government tele-mental-health helpline could be verified from an official source.

BMU: renamed from BSMMU (Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujib Medical University). psychiatry.bsmmu.ac.bd serves the same content as psychiatry.bmu.ac.bd. The psychiatry department page lists no clinical service details or department phone.

University of Dhaka: the Nasirullah Psychotherapy Unit site npudu.org shows only a 'Coming Soon' page, npudu.org/adult-clinic/ returns 404 and npudu.net returns 503. Search-snippet details (open Sat-Thu 10am-5pm, 3rd floor Arts Building, open to anyone in the community) could NOT be confirmed on a live official page. The DU Student Counselling & Guidance office page (du.ac.bd/offices/OSC) returned HTTP 500, and the alternate page only lists 'Individual counseling session' in an old 2020 activity plan, so that office is not included (it serves students only).

BRAC (NGO): the verified material describes only employee counselling and paracounsellor programmes in Rohingya camps, with no service open to the public, so BRAC is not included. BRAC University's counselling page returned HTTP 403 (UNCERTAIN entry).

NTCC: phone numbers seen in search snippets (+88-02-8321041, +88-02-9352450) come from Wikipedia or old sources, not the official page, so they are not included. ntcc-mowca.gov.bd could not be reached.

Not included because they could not be verified from an official site: Talk Hope (+880 9638 881 888) and Alapon (09678609609), listed only on findahelpline.com, and the Bangladesh Mahila Parishad victim helpline (01717 363 647).

BCPS publishes member lists, not a searchable 'find a psychologist' directory. Many members work abroad or in academia and may not take clients. bcps.org.bd has an expired TLS certificate, so browsers will show a warning.

Moner Bondhu, Mindspace/Vent and SHOJON use ordinary paid numbers, not toll-free ones. Mindspace's page shows '100% Free & Confidential' near its services, but it is unclear what that covers, so is_free is null.
